searchText: **EOF Implementers Call #45** Meeting Info: May 08, 2024 , 15:00 UTC Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1034 Recording: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJqWcTqh_zKHu7Z91YVYWy_PSmOc_66-F Zoom: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/88940506383?pwd=aTdsbHVyMTNDSUFHYmhTWlI2ZEVldz09 How does eip 7702 work with eof? Replaces TXCREATE. the code needs to be validated, but it is never deployed The code can call EOFCREATE and I guess this is what Paweł meant. The semantics of EOF validation would need to be carefully looked at though. i think the gas costing needs to be considered. EOF contract creation "hides" gas cost in the 200 gas per deployed bytecode, but if it's not being deployed, then there should be a surcharge for validation No. tx data cost is enough. Validation charge is supposed to be covered in EIP-3860 cost (which we don't charge indeed), and tx data cost (the latter much higher anyway) validation is truly that cheap? 16 gas per byte for traversing the code once? It surely is.
